== Summary ==
Title banner for [[Virtual Block 7]] ("Ultimate Power"), from the cover page of the Virtual Block 7.1: Ultimate Power PDF. Its cover reads "Official text as of June 18, 2010". The file was created on 28 July 2010.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf VirtualBlock7_1.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 300 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover image, and cropped to the banner (1954&times;1204 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/0f/Set-VB7-logo.jpg Internet Archive item].
